narratives.text: Insured reports rear-end collision at a city intersection. Airbags deployed. No injuries reported. Photos and police report attached.
Water damage from burst pipe on second floor. Contents inventory incomplete. Temporary housing requested.
Theft from locked vehicle overnight. Laptop and tools stolen. Prior theft claim within 12 months.
Windstorm damaged commercial roof. Temporary tarp in place. Business interruption claimed for three days.
Slip and fall in retail aisle. Customer seeking medical expenses. CCTV available.
Cargo shipment delayed due to weather. Partial spoilage reported for refrigerated goods.
Cyber incident: ransomware on billing workstation. Systems restored from backup. No confirmed data exfiltration.
Glass breakage at storefront after overnight vandalism. Alarm did not trigger. Suspect vehicle on nearby camera.
Employee injury during loading dock operations. Workers compensation notice filed. Safety review requested.
Hail damage to vehicle fleet parked outdoors. Multiple units affected. Repair estimates pending.
